newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Sears estimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Sears estimates cut.

text.p: Prudential Securities said analyst Wayne Hood cut his second quarter estimate on Sears, Roebuck and Co to $0.73 a share from $0.76.
-- cited in a report softer-than-expected sales of seasonal merchandise in April and early May.
-- lowered second quarter FIFO gross margin estimate to 26.34 percent from 26.50 percent, compared with 26.34 percent last year, to reflect higher buying and occupancy expenses.
-- said expects provision for uncollectible accounts to increase to 35 percent in the second quarter compared with a prior 25 percent estimate and the first quarter's 18.5 percent increase.
-- Hood's full-year 1997 estimate dropped to $3.50 a share from $3.55.
-- maintains hold rating on the stock.
